newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Digicall in funding talk with Vodafone.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Digicall in funding talk with Vodafone.

text.p: Mobile telecommunications reseller Digicall Ltd said on Wednesday the company was in dicussing the future funding of its business with its network provider Vodafone and other telephone companies.
"These discussions are continuing with a view to formulating a poroposal for submission to shareholders," Digicall said.

The company said a review of its subscriber base had found a substantial number of uneconomic customers. Digicall said it now estimated its bad debts to be in the region of A$11 million at June 30, 1996 with only A$2 million provided for in the half year accounts to December 31, 1995.
In addition, the company said its estimate of unamortised deferred costs relating to uneconomic subscribers that it expects to disconnect were in the region of A$5 million.
"The directors believe it is prudent to provide for this write off in June 1996 accounts," the company said.
The company said while its remaining subscribers would represent a quality base, the disconnevtions would adversely impact its results for the year ended June 30, 1996.
Digicall said it estimated as a result of its subscriber base clean-up, there would be no net growth in its digital subscriber base in the quarter ending September 30, 1996.
Trading in Digicall shares was halted at the company's request earlier on Wednesday. The shares last traded at 40 cents, up 2.5 cents on the day.
